organizations.name: Roadward Accord
organizations.role: Cross-faction road crews, bridge arbitration and safe-passage witnesses. Membership or standing grants repair commissions, not political citizenship.

organizations.name: Hearth Assembly
organizations.role: Cross-faction food, gardens and practical knowledge. Mentor Vesa serves this civic body. It is not the Hearthward League and cannot set permanent allegiance.

organizations.name: Veil Survey
organizations.role: Cross-faction waystone research, cartography and fictional affliction study. Cooperation does not override faction restrictions.

enemies.name: Hollow Covenant
enemies.role: A clandestine movement that manipulates waystone disturbances and incites factions to abandon shared warning duties. It exploits human political failures; the ancient waystone mystery is not reduced to its creation.

relations.symmetry: symmetric_base_and_overrides; author one canonical unordered pair

pairs.motive: Road restoration crosses sacred groves; each side contests who can authorize land use.
Frontier surveys overlap ancestral ridge claims; defensive patrols are read as occupation.
Both value commerce, but the Compact rejects imposed inland tolls and route ownership.
Both recognize ancestral stewardship; mineral extraction and patrol access remain disputed.
Negotiated access is common ground; timber exports and private dredging cause friction.
Harbors can recognize clan trade without recognizing every territorial claim or privateer.

policy.pvp_extension: Future separate opt-in consent/mode evaluator before the existing combat target validator; no shipped PvP toggle, reward, queue or damage override.

cooperation.chat: Existing block, moderation and recipient rules; no faction cipher.
cooperation.trade: Neutral or guest-pass-authorized service areas; escrow, bind, distance and sanctions still apply.
cooperation.private_headquarters: No automatic party or guild teleport/admission. Each member needs their own eligibility.
cooperation.quest_credit: Each character receives only authoritative evidence for their own eligible quest; never copy allegiance, choices or rewards.

resolution.rule: Most distinct authenticated account ballots; a tie or empty round selects shared-passage. Pin electorate rule, cutoff, options and policy version when opening the round.

policy.continuation: Disabling new selection never changes FactionId. Keep version-pinned definitions/rewards and safe fallback available; unresolved story content is deferred in the personal journal, not deleted or auto-completed.
